uncertainties: Checked whether Alashiya (Cyprus) as a state should be founded earlier than -1600, since the place-name appears in Mari/Alalakh texts from the 18th century BC. Left unchanged: scholarship treats the earlier references as naming a copper source/region, with the unified kingdom emerging in the 1700-1400 BC window per DailyHistory/Wikipedia — -1600 sits inside that range, so this is a defensible judgment call, not an error.

Checked whether Talaiotic culture (BAL) should split off earlier than -1300 (some sources say c. 1600 BC cyclopean constructions, others say as late as 1000-800 BC for true talayots). The file's -1300 pick is a mainstream middle position; left unchanged as within scholarly disagreement, per the brief's guidance not to churn defensible calls.
